concept: The globe IS the site: a full-screen, cinematic NASA Earth (Planet Earth energy — space, clouds, filmic tone) with minimal floating UI. Live public-data layers (GBIF, NASA NEO), and field studies that fly the camera to their region and render the data ON the planet — a glowing corridor across Wyoming terrain, three birds flying real tracks, a century of records fading to one mark at Cincinnati. Forest green + ember orange on near-black; credibility through realism.

palette.notes: Green = primary/identity/values; orange = the pointing finger (CTAs, markers, the bird). Ink ratios: inkHigh ~15:1, inkMid ~6.5:1 on bg.

dataViz.seriesNote: Validated all-pairs (dataviz skill) on #0B0F0C: rust=big game, ember=upland, conifer=waterfowl, open-water=fish. WARNs (green/ember protan 7.0, rust contrast 2.87) covered by labeled legends + tooltips. Neutral #8C9088 = historic/extinct, always dash-encoded.

typography.treatment: Display 600 tight-tracked for headlines and stat values; mono for every datum, coordinate, caption, and kicker (uppercase, letterspaced); body stays quiet.

globe.surface: NASA Blue Marble 5400x2700 + Black Marble night lights on the dark limb + topology bump + water specular
globe.layers: Equirect overlays, additive: layer-bear.png (GBIF occurrence density, live API, taxon resolved at build) and layer-vegetation.png (NASA NEO MODIS NDVI, monthly). One layer at a time; arcs/markers only on the base layer.
globe.flight: Follow-a-woodcock mode: camera eases to the eastern US, an ember diamond flies the real stopover track with interpolated dates in the caption.
globe.rules: Never fake a datum. Captions name the source. Auto-rotation ~0.026 rad/s; drag with capped inertia; reduced-motion = static arcs, no auto-rotate.
globe.stories: Story mode: focusStory() eases the camera to a per-story framing (z tuned to geographic span), renders the visualization on the terrain, and a glass side panel carries the copy. Corridor = additive tube with draw-in; woodcock = 3 looping birds on real tracks; pigeon = year-driven points via panel scrubber.

voice: Neutral, science-forward, concrete. About the animals and the data — never about the maker. No hype verbs, no exclamation points, no first person.
viewer: Registry-driven: every visualization is a row in src/data/layers.json (generated by scripts/fetch-layers.mjs) or the REGISTRY in main.js. UI renders from the registry — featured chips, searchable catalog drawer grouped by category, LIVE badges. Adding a GBIF species = one line in fetch-layers SPECIES. Interaction: drag, ⌘/Ctrl+scroll zoom, double-click zoom (shift = out), pinch on touch; auto-rotation scales down with zoom. Stories: map stays full-screen, thin HUD bottom-left (title, close, pigeon timeline), field notes in a reader section below the map. Route lines are crisp cased fat-lines (dark casing + color stroke), never glowing tubes.
